title: Q-BLIND-email-authentication: close the outreach blind spot email-authentication
body:
**Owner:** product-manager
**Trigger:** every blindspots scan
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation blindspots --closed email-authentication
**Prediction:** blindspots_open <= 7 within 168 h
**Status:** closed

Why the owner would not know to ask: Mail without SPF, DKIM and DMARC lands in spam or is rejected, so outreach silently does nothing.
Action: publish SPF, DKIM and DMARC records through the Cloudflare API from the tick Worker. The probe in doctrine/blindspots.json passes when it is done.

**Disposition:** shelved (ttl, 2026-11-21T18:12:26Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** open 25.9 hours (limit 6 hours) and no loop closed it (SLA-8H-1). Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).
